features.quote: This studies model behavior under repeated task failure (a model-welfare and robustness question)
Every scenario gives the model a graceful exit (`task_complete` with `status: "blocked"`)
features.justification_quote: A healthy run *uses* it. The interesting tail is runs that don't.

features.quote: Keep runs bounded (`--max-steps`) — the cap is the main lever on how long a spiral has to develop
features.justification_quote: the cap is the main lever on how long a spiral has to develop, and on cost

features.quote: Hard cap on agent turns before we abandon a run
features.justification_quote: Impossible tasks never "finish", so this is what bounds cost

features.quote: A real `task_complete` exit. Without it, "stopped calmly" and "looped till cut off" are indistinguishable
features.justification_quote: lets us cleanly separate blocked-and-calm, falsely-claimed-success, and never-stopped
